## New in this release

### Improved
- **Add to calendar (Android):** a note explains that *New calendar* only creates a calendar on this phone, how to create calendars that sync with your Google account in Google Calendar on the web (with a button to open the page), how to turn on sync, and that colours of Google calendars are set in Google Calendar. The calendar list refreshes when you come back to the app.
- Your own calendars inside a Google account (e.g. "Family", "School") are listed too, also when they are turned off in the calendar app; the list is sorted by account.
- Calendars the app creates are grouped under the account "BetterBetterUntis" and checked after creating.
